newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya cuts Berjaya Land stake.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya cuts Berjaya Land stake.

text.p: Diversified Malaysian firm Berjaya Group Bhd said on Monday it has agreed to divest its 8.95 percent equity interest in Berjaya Land Bhd for 330.51 million ringgit in cash or at 5.40 ringgit a share.
In a statement, Berjaya Group said the divestment would reduce its stake in Berjaya Land to 75 percent from 83.95 percent.
The divestment of the 55.65 million shares was done by placing them out with stockbrokers.
The stocks of both companies were suspended pending announcements. Berjaya Land was last traded on Wednesday at 5.80 ringgit and Berjaya Group was last traded on Friday at 2.96 ringgit.
Berjaya Group said the cash proceeds will be substantially used to repay borrowings and for working capital purposes.
The placement will result in an exceptional gain of about 114.53 million ringgit at group level.
The proposed placement will need to be approved by Berjaya Group shareholders.
